bar.label: Config apply
bar.applying: Applying the config on the device…

blocked.unreachable: metabox is not responding, applying is unavailable now.
blocked.unparsed: The config text has an error on line {{line}}: fix it to apply.

unsent: metabox did not answer, nothing was sent to the device. Try again.

discard.title: Discard every draft edit?
discard.description: The draft resets to the config on the device. This cannot be undone.

stale.title: The config on the router changed after editing started
stale.description: Applying overwrites those changes. Check the diff or discard the draft.

confirm.prompt: The config is applied. Confirm that the link is alive —
confirm.rollback: otherwise the daemon restores the previous one

clashApi.title: metabox added experimental.clash_api to the config
clashApi.description: Without it the status screens are empty. The service was restarted by the same apply.

failure.rolledBack: No confirmation arrived — the previous config was restored

reason.backup_failed: the previous config was not saved, there is nothing to write over
reason.write_failed: the config was not written to the device
reason.restart_failed: the service did not restart with the new config
reason.healthcheck_failed: the service started, but sing-box did not answer
reason.dns_probe_failed: sing-box started but does not answer DNS queries: check the DNS section
reason.interception_missing: after the restart, traffic interception from the network stopped working
reason.rollback_failed: the previous config could not be restored — the new one stayed on the device
reason.no_backup: there was nothing to roll back to: the device had no config before this apply, so the service stayed on the new one

check.title: sing-box rejected the config — nothing was written to the device
check.exitCode: Exit code: {{code}}. The draft is kept: fix it and apply again.

workdir.title: The sing-box service runs from another directory: applying stopped
workdir.description: Lists go to {{configDir}}, but the service looks in {{workdir}}. Point it at the config directory and restart it:
workdir.sideEffect: Other relative service paths, such as cache.db, will also resolve from the config directory.

diff.description: Check the changes. After applying, confirm the connection works, otherwise metabox restores the previous config.
diff.title: What goes to the device
diff.same: The draft matches the file on the device.
diff.caption: Line by line difference between the draft and the applied config

history.title: Version history
history.description: The last 10 applies. “Restore” applies a version the same way: with a check and a connection confirmation.
